sloka: देवताश्चाभवन् हृष्टास्तत्रस्थास्तस्य कर्मणा ।काञ्चनस्य सुनाभस्य सहस्राक्षश्च वासवः ॥५-१-१३८॥
transliteration: devatāścābhavan hṛṣṭāstatrasthāstasya karmaṇā ।kāñcanasya sunābhasya sahasrākṣaśca vāsavaḥ ॥5-1-138॥

translations.english: The gods who happened to be present at that time (on the mountain) and the thousandeyed Indra were delighted by the gesture of golden Sunabha (Mainaka) mountain.
